validated_results.title: In vivo pharmacodynamics of indole-3-carbinol in the inhibition of prostate cancer in transgenic adenocarcinoma of mouse prostate (TRAMP) mice: involvement of Nrf2 and cell cycle/apoptosis signaling pathways.
validated_results.reason: The study evaluates indole-3-carbinol only in TRAMP mice and cell lines (HepG2-C8, TRAMP C1), providing no human data on incident prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: 17α-Estradiol and genistein inhibit high fat diet induced prostate gene expression and prostate growth in the rat.
validated_results.reason: Genistein effects were tested exclusively in ACI/Seg rats on prostate gene expression and growth, with no human participants or cancer incidence outcome.

validated_results.title: 17α-Estradiol and genistein inhibit high fat diet induced prostate gene expression and prostate growth in the rat.
validated_results.reason: The low- versus high-fat diet comparison was conducted solely in rats measuring prostate growth and mRNA, not human prostate cancer incidence.

validated_results.title: Vitamin D deficiency in the urological population: a single center analysis.
validated_results.reason: This retrospective review reports prevalence of vitamin D deficiency in urological patients and treats existing urological malignancy as a predictor, providing no separable estimate for incident prostate cancer.
